# speexdsp (vendored subset)

From https://github.com/xiph/speexdsp at 7a158783df74efe7c2d1c6ee8363c1e695c71226 (BSD-style, see COPYING).
Only the echo canceller (mdf), preprocessor (denoise / residual echo / VAD) and resampler,
built float with KISS FFT. Used by the SonoRocket capture app for talkback.
